categories.appliances: Small Kitchen Appliances Worth the Counter Space

products.name: Pipishell Bamboo Expandable Silverware Drawer Organizer
products.blurb: Expands from 13" to almost 20" wide, so it actually fits your drawer instead of the other way around. Seven compartments keep forks, spoons, and knives from turning into a junk pile.
